take.name: take
take.summary: Reach for a thing, close the hand on its grip, lift it to carry.

carry.name: carry
carry.summary: Hold a taken thing in front of the hip.

give.name: give
give.summary: Hold out a carried thing to someone facing you and let go once they have it.

receive.name: receive
receive.summary: Take a thing someone facing you holds out, and bring it in to carry.
